standard.title: SOLID CARBIDE PARALLEL SHANK TWIST DRILLS STUB SERIES — SPECIFICATION
standard.description: This standard specifies the dimensions, tolerances, and general requirements of solid carbide parallel shank twist drills in the stub series, designed primarily for right-hand cutting applications.
standard.scope: This standard specifies the dimensions, tolerances, and general requirements of solid carbide parallel shank twist drills in the stub series, designed primarily for right-hand cutting applications.

relationships.description: Uses IS 2 : 1960 as a normative reference for requirements relevant to this standard.

certification.description: Conformity assessment and standard licensing are supported by the Bureau of Indian Standards Certification Marking scheme, with compliance systems administered directly by BIS under the BIS Act, 1986.
requirements: Twist drills conforming to this standard must be manufactured specifically for right-hand cutting applications.

Solid carbide twist drills must be designated by the product name, stub series designation, nominal drill diameter, and carbide grade class conforming to this standard. Example: 'Twist Drill 6.00 K40 IS 16060'.
The dimensional tolerance applied to the overall length (l1) of the finished twist drill must belong to the 'very coarse' grade defined in IS 2102 (Part 1).
To prevent wobbling and uneven hole sizing during high-speed machining, the tolerance on the radial runout of the twist drill must be held strictly within 0.02 mm.
Enforces strict limits on the relative lip height tolerance to ensure even cutting force distribution on both lips.
The product may carry the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Use is strictly regulated under the statutory provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986.
